beats.say: A $5 razor that never stops charging you.
Buy the razor alone, no blades.
Buy razor plus a handful of blades.
Buy razor, blades, and a premium case.
First year sold 51 razors, 168 blades. Looks odd.
But it forces repeat blade purchases.
The cheap razor lures you, then you need blades.
Year two, 90,884 razors sold - blades skyrocketed.
Each razor creates a lifelong blade demand.
Gym sells a $30 starter bike, then $5 per ride.
Coffee shop offers a $2 mug, then $0.25 per refill.
The recurring cost feels cheap compared to the one-time fee.
Watch for a cheap entry that hides a subscription. Follow for more.
